arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Unemployment Trust Fund total balance values (from the Balance column)
# FY 1936-1942
balances = {
    1936: 18.9,
    1937: 312.4,
    1938: 884.2,
    1939: 1280.5,
    1940: 1724.9,
    1941: 2283.7,
    1942: 3150.1
}

# Calculate 4-year moving averages
# FY 1936-1939, 1937-1940, 1938-1941, 1939-1942
moving_averages = []
for start_year in [1936, 1937, 1938, 1939]:
    end_year = start_year + 3
    years = [start_year, start_year+1, start_year+2, start_year+3]
    values = [balances[y] for y in years]
    avg = sum(values) / 4
    moving_averages.append(avg)
    print(f"FY {start_year}-{end_year}: {values} = {avg}")

print("\nAll 4-year moving averages:", moving_averages)
print(f"Min: {min(moving_averages)}")
print(f"Max: {max(moving_averages)}")
print(f"Range: {min(moving_averages)} - {max(moving_averages)}")
print(f"Range rounded to nearest tenth: {round(min(moving_averages), 1)} - {round(max(moving_averages), 1)}")
EOF
